description: Isolated 3-cycle a->b->c->a beside a separate DAG d->e->f, d->f. One CyclicDependency (members a,b,c; 3 internal edges). Not BigBallOfMud: two undirected triangles, modularity = 2*(3/6 - (6/12)^2) = 0.5 > 0.30. No hub: fan_in and fan_out fences are both 1 + 1.5*0 = 1, and only f (fan_in 2) and d (fan_out 2) pass one of them. No unstable dependency: the cycle members all have instability 1/2, and the DAG goes from I = 1 to 1/2 to 0.
